definitions.explanation: A counter for counting the duration of time in months. Different from {月|がつ} which is used for naming specific months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しています→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I have been studying Japanese for three months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{六|ろっ}→六：00747_roku⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧
examples.notes: Note: ろっかげつ with small っ

examples.japanese: ⟦あと→後：09580_ato⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many more months will it take?

examples.japanese: ⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦やせました→痩せる：01146_yaseru⟧。
examples.english: I lost five kilos in one month.
examples.notes: Note: いっかげつ with small っ

examples.japanese: ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧ヶ{月|げつ}⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|こ}ませんでした→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Even after waiting ten months, no letter came.

notes: ヶ{月|げつ} counts the duration in months. It's written with the small ヶ character. Common forms include {一|いっ}ヶ{月|げつ} (one month), {二|に}ヶ{月|げつ} (two months), {六|ろっ}ヶ{月|げつ} (six months - note the っ), {十|じゅっ}ヶ{月|げつ} (ten months). Compare with {月|がつ} (for naming months: {一|いち}{月|がつ} = January).
